author: michal-miotk
title: OpenVINO JS API tests crash with unhandled ECONNRESET downloading test model
signature: failed to download the model failed to send request error read econnreset|Network

failed_jobs.name: OpenVINO JS API (22) / OpenVINO JS API
failed_jobs.symptom: test_setup.js crashes with unhandled promise rejection while downloading v3-small_224_1.0_float.bin from storage.openvinotoolkit.org

key_errors: Failed to download the model: Failed to send request: Error: read ECONNRESET..

UnhandledPromiseRejection: This error originated either by throwing inside of an async function without a catch block, or by rejecting a promise which was not handled with .catch(). The promise rejected with the reason "Failed to send request: Error: read ECONNRESET.".
root_cause: src/bindings/js/node/tests/setup.js downloads test models over HTTP(S) before running the JS API unit tests. The download of v3-small_224_1.0_float.bin from storage.openvinotoolkit.org failed with a TCP connection reset (ECONNRESET), a transient network condition unrelated to the PR under test (which only touches src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/runtime/ze/ze_memory.cpp). The download promise rejection is not wrapped in a try/catch, so Node.js terminates the process with ERR_UNHANDLED_REJECTION instead of retrying or failing gracefully.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible locally; it depends on a transient network reset while fetching https://storage.openvinotoolkit.org/.../v3-small_224_1.0_float.bin during `node ./tests/setup.js` in src/bindings/js/node. Can be approximated by injecting a network fault (e.g., iptables RST) while running `npm run test_setup` in that directory.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed merge-queue jobs; this failure is unrelated to the PR's actual GPU/ZE code change.
Harden src/bindings/js/node/tests/setup.js to retry model downloads a few times with backoff and to catch/reject cleanly instead of leaving an unhandled promise rejection.
Consider caching test models in CI (or using a mirror) to reduce dependence on storage.openvinotoolkit.org availability.
prevention_strategies: Add retry-with-backoff and explicit .catch() handling around all test-model download promises in setup.js so transient network resets degrade into a clear, actionable test failure instead of an unhandled rejection that crashes the whole test run.
historical_context: This is a new failure signature for this doctor (first occurrence of ECONNRESET during JS API model download). A related but distinct pattern (84f05233a122ae35's neighbor 197368415f8ae13d: 'request was timed out downloading test model from raw.githubusercontent.com', Network, count=4) shows OpenVINO JS API tests have repeatedly failed on flaky external model downloads from different hosts (raw.githubusercontent.com, 503 from the same host) — suggesting the JS API test setup's dependency on external, non-cached model hosts is a recurring source of merge-queue flakiness.
